primary_estimands.interval: two-sided Student-t 95% interval over ten untouched panels (df=9)
primary_estimands.gate: All provenance/alignment checks pass and all four two-sided 95% lower confidence bounds are strictly positive.

confirmation_gate: All provenance/alignment checks pass and all four two-sided 95% lower confidence bounds are strictly positive.
post_score_audit: Only after all decoder scores are frozen, compute BGE support recall at 1/2/3 passages and report it without tuning.
interpretation: Post-confirmation full factorial on the already frozen untouched QA1/QA2/QA3 panels. It tests whether the positive co-scaled curve reflects actual model-dependent use of ASCENT state rather than certified state size alone.

factorial_design.estimand: Exact generative ASCENT accuracy in all nine model-by-state cells; state main effects, fixed-state model effects, model-by-state interactions, and co-scaled improvement beyond memory-only scaling.
factorial_design.gate: All provenance and Foundation-invariance checks pass; the co-scaled diagonal has positive adjacent gain lower bounds; and both adjacent model-by-state interaction lower bounds are positive for the matched 1-to-2 and 2-to-3 state expansions.

fresh_factorial_design.objective: Test whether larger frozen language models extract a statistically increasing benefit from larger ASCENT state on five untouched official BABILong QA1-QA3 panels.

panel_selection.ordering: ascending SHA-256 of canonical official rows

primary_analysis.interval: two-sided Student-t 95% interval over five untouched panels (df=4)
primary_analysis.coscale_excess: co-scaled gain increment minus memory-only gain increment at the lower model
primary_analysis.gate: All provenance/alignment checks pass; both diagonal gain-increment LCBs, both registered model-by-state interaction LCBs, and both co-scale-excess LCBs are strictly positive.

supporting_analysis.interval: two-sided Student-t 95% interval over the three previous plus five fresh panels (df=7)
supporting_analysis.gate: The same six lower bounds are strictly positive in the combined eight-panel analysis.
supporting_analysis.role: supporting replication; it cannot replace failure of the fresh-only primary gate

fresh_factorial_design.stopping_rule: Run all 45 cells and report every primary/supporting estimand without panel or task deletion.
fresh_factorial_design.promotion_rule: Do not claim generative scale complementarity unless the fresh-only primary gate passes. Do not claim evidence far beyond TNNLS unless both fresh-only and combined gates pass and an independent task or model family also confirms the final protocol.

supporting_combined_gate: The same six lower bounds are strictly positive in the combined eight-panel analysis.

focused_confirmation_design.objective: Independently confirm the two marginal estimands from the untouched five-panel factorial with maximum remaining disjoint official BABILong QA1-QA3 panels.

panel_selection.ordering: ascending SHA-256 of canonical official rows

primary_analysis.interval: two-sided Student-t 95% interval over ten untouched panels (df=9)
primary_analysis.gate: All provenance/alignment checks pass and all four two-sided 95% lower confidence bounds are strictly positive.

focused_confirmation_design.stopping_rule: Run all 50 focused cells and report every panel and estimand without panel, task, prediction, or outlier deletion.
focused_confirmation_design.interpretation_rule: This is a prospective independent confirmation of the two marginal estimands, not a retroactive pass of the failed five-panel primary gate. The earlier five-panel outcome remains reported unchanged.
focused_confirmation_design.promotion_rule: Promotion requires the focused primary gate plus an independent model or task family; statistical significance alone is not described as far beyond TNNLS.
